architecture.workflow: LangGraph routing, in-memory checkpoint, pause/resume and bounded coordination
architecture.roles: Deterministic synthetic fixtures; role names are not independent experts
architecture.state: Runtime output contracts and state types, separate from CEC research schemas
architecture.capabilities: Fixed permitted operations and protected output-root checks; not an OS sandbox
architecture.adapters: Read-only local packet access only; no provider or research-service adapters
architecture.tracing: Single implementation moved byte-for-byte; old path becomes a forwarding entry point
architecture.specification: Runtime accepts explicit, digest-checked specification; original evidence spec remains in one location
architecture.compatibility: Existing notebook and helper entry paths remain available through thin forwarding adapters
architecture.packaging: Normal wheel installation must work outside the source checkout; no copying evidence into wheel
architecture.ci: Read-only final workflows test installed distribution, exact behavior equivalence and preserved research

requirements.rule: Preserve every existing evidence file, root README, root notebook and notebook URLs.
Separate runtime responsibilities without enabling live execution, publishing or reviewer approval.

Compare full deterministic role inputs/outputs, transitions, plan and traces against frozen baseline; ignore only documented timestamps, hash-chain values derived from timestamps and temporary absolute run path.
Keep one authoritative prompt/spec location; fail if its file checksum changes.
Build and install a wheel, then import and run from outside the checkout without PYTHONPATH pointing at src.
Preserve original capture behavior and helper/CLI entry points without a second runtime implementation.
Retain budget, privacy, authority, source-ID, synthetic-only and pause/resume regression tests.
Prevent repository-write destinations and keep remote source adapters absent; document limitations of process-local guards.
Update existing Chapters 17 and 09 instead of adding another reading chapter.
Record AI contribution and real validation evidence; no independent scientific or safety certification.

non_goals: No new theological or legal conclusion
No durable production checkpoint or authenticated approval claim
authorization: The user approved the bounded architecture recommendation. This authorizes engineering maintenance, not completion of issue #41 or execution of the confirmatory study.
